Please add the folder background feature like Windows XP.


comments: Thank you for your feedback, we're currently tracking a feature request for a setting a background image for the app. While these are two separate requests, it makes sense to track them together because the implementation details are similar. #12636
On second thought, let's continue tracking this here.

@xmha97 I have a proof of concept in #15632, but we are going to do further research before committing to this feature.

![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/39923744/4eab5674-3d65-49d7-8b24-ee43f385a07a)
@xmha97 this feature has been merged into `main` and will be included in the next release.

> @xmha97 this feature has been merged into `main` and will be included in the next release.

Can I set folder background image on file properties dialog box?

> Can I set folder background image on file properties dialog box?

@xmha97 That is not supported yet (not planned yet).
In the meantime, please copy&paste

```
[FilesApp]
Files_BackgroundImage=C:\Users\USERNAME\Desktop\folderimage.png
Files_BackgroundOpacity=1.0
Files_BackgroundFit=UniformToFill
Files_BackgroundVerticalAlignment=Top
Files_BackgroundHorizontalAlignment=Left
```

Please note:
- Only absolute path is supported for now
- Those names may change in the further update until we setle on within a few weeks. But, after we documented, it's out of preview.
